compound_library.mechanism: Bispecific antibody that simultaneously binds BCMA on plasma cells and CD3 on T cells, redirecting T cell cytotoxicity to deplete autoantibody-producing plasma cells

compound_library.name: Anti-CD19 CAR-T Cell Therapy
compound_library.mechanism: Autologous T cells engineered with anti-CD19 chimeric antigen receptor (CAR) that deplete CD19+ B cells including autoreactive clones and plasmablasts. Potential for deep B cell reset and drug-free remission.
